title: Captain Bombardier
subtitle: Independent
description: As a former Imperial, Captain Bombardier joined the New Republic Amnesty program and was tasked with helping rebuild the planet Plazir-15. It was there that he fell in love with the Duchess. When The Mandalorian Din Djarin and Bo-Katan Kryze visit, he asks for their help dealing with a Droid problem they believe to be a coordinated malfunction.
